description: Check the caller's own Website Auditor subscription standing. Use this when someone asks "am I on Pro," "is my trial still active," "when does my subscription renew/end," "why is this tool locked," or before suggesting an upgrade. Works with any valid API key and consumes no audit quota. Returns the tier (none/free/pro), raw subscription status, period end, whether the subscription is set to cancel, the upgrade URL, and a plain-language summary — including what starting Pro requires (a payment method and accepting the Terms).
name: check_upgrade_status

status.description: Raw subscription status: active, trialing, canceled, none, …

title: Check upgrade status
